summary: An IAB document about protocol designs that add metadata to encrypted flows. It argues that designs sharing metadata only by explicit action at the host are better than designs where middleboxes insert it. It follows RFC 7624, on pervasive attacks.

eli5.summary: If a sealed letter gets sticky notes added by strangers along the way, that can leak secrets. Better to let the sender add notes.

questions: why middleboxes should not insert metadata
